summary: Update contract field section with new UI/UX
description:
## Background:

This epic is to update the Frontend of the contract, specifically the fields section after we have now received the new/final design.

This consists of:
- Creating subsections for the different contract parts (e.g. seller, vehicle)
- Re-arranging of all fields
- Adding new fields if necessary, including the fields that are hidden by show if logic
- Updating field types if necessary
- Adding "required" to all applicable fields
- Adding headers and subheaders
- Adding translation keys for all fields, headers, bodies in the field section
- Adding validation to the fields where applicable
- Adding UI for the different contract states
- Adding UI for buyer and seller

## Goal:

Update the fields section UI for the contract service.

## Scope:
- Build the whole UI/UX for the fields section (From 1. Verkäufer - 6. Unterzeichnung) in the digital contract
- web app and mweb

## Out of scope:
- Other sections besides the field section
- No further logic in the signing section
- Buttons should not lead anywhere
- signing section

## Resources:
- List of all fields, translations, formatting: Google Sheets (see ticket)
- Design: Figma QCT - Digital Contract Q3 2026 (node-id=12234-74109)
- Translations and keys: Google Sheets (see ticket)
